model: AUDEMARS PIGUET Royal Oak Chronograph 41 26240ST (41 mm steel, green Grande Tapisserie dial, steel bracelet)
note: Front relief, follower of the Royal Oak Chronograph template (white variant 26240st-white): same structure, only the trace / maps / dial emission differ (green dial, catalog row 93).

case.note: case slab = silhouette between the lug tops (tip_top / tip_bottom, 0.25 mm grid, sum a multiple of 0.25) with the pusher and crown rows replaced by straight lines, top and bottom sloping toward the bracelet; bezel = octagon ring (min of the octagon and the silhouette less silhouette_margin_mm, sampled by rays) at bezel_z, then a chamfer ring down to the opening at chamfer_z; the silhouette flank is about 1.4 px wider per side than the bezel octagon, hence verified_tol_mm 0.5

dial.note: flat waffle plate out to opening.dial_flat_mm, step up to the chapter-ring plane ring_z out to the opening; one lathe with the photo map

hands.note: profile = [mm along the hand from the pivot (negative = tail), half width] from tail to tip, last point at the traced length; read on rotated 14x crops of the photo (hand axes: hour 304.0 deg with its centre line 2.0 px counter-clockwise of the pivot axis, minute 50.3 deg, chrono-seconds tail 227.3 deg ending 99.4 px from the pivot; the needle's upper half is hidden behind the minute hand and not modelled). Hands and hub use hands_photo (reference photo projected from the front)

crown.note: crown and the two pushers come from trace.crowns: hexagonal nut (flat face toward the viewer) from the base point along the axis angle, then a short cylindrical cap ring (ring_shift_mm = off-axis shift of the cap)

strap.note: strap.kind links: chain of full-width links (strap.links.pieces_mm [|y0|, |y1|], top and bottom separately) with the dark joint gaps between them; backing_mm = y range of the steel_photo backing under the gaps and the polished pins; link outline from the silhouette (edge_from = lug tips)

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
